name: random_quote
description: Fetch a single random inspirational quote (author + text) from ZenQuotes; falls back to dummyjson automatically if ZenQuotes is unavailable. Response includes _source field when served from fallback.

name: today_quote
description: Get the quote of the day from ZenQuotes. Returns the same quote for all requests within a given day.

name: list_quotes
description: Fetch a batch of up to 50 random inspirational quotes (author + text each) from ZenQuotes; falls back to dummyjson if ZenQuotes is unavailable. Response includes count, quotes array, and _source when from fallback.
